names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 25 ianuarie, «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Teologul, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's own heading for 25. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-07), „Свети Григорије Богослов, архиепископ цариградски“. The word „Свети“ is left off and so is the office „архиепископ цариградски“. „Богослов“ is kept: the entry treats it as the name he is called by rather than a rank — „због чега је и назват Богословом“, which is why he was named the Theologian.

birth.note: The year the Orthodox Church in America’s life gives.

death.note: The year printed beside his name on days.pravoslavie.ru for 25 January (old style).

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 25 января ст. ст. — «Свт. Григория Богослова, архиеп. Константинопольского (389)»

attestations.note: The same calendar keeps him again on 30 января ст. ст., in the Synaxis of the Ecumenical Teachers and Hierarchs — «Собор Вселенских учителей и святителей Василия Великого, Григория Богослова и Иоанна Златоустого» — which names the three of them and no one else. That is a joint commemoration and not a feast of his own, so this row stands on his own day and the second day is recorded here; the saint is not rendered on it.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 25 ianuarie — «Sfântul Ierarh Grigorie Teologul, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului»
Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 25 Ιανουαρίου — «Άγιος Γρηγόριος ο Θεολόγος»

attestations.note: The same calendar keeps him a second time, five days later, in the joint feast of the Three Hierarchs: saint.gr's list for 30 Ιανουαρίου opens with «Άγιοι Τρεις Ιεράρχες» (https://www.saint.gr/01/30/index.aspx, read 30 September 2026), which is Basil the Great, Gregory the Theologian and John Chrysostom together. One attestation row per church is the schema, so the second day is recorded here and he renders on the twenty-fifth.

feast.note: The Ohrid Prologue keeps him again on 30. јануар ст. ст. (civil 2026-02-12, https://www.pravoslavno.rs/index.php?q=citanja&datum=2026-02-12&prolog=1, read 3 October 2026), under the joint heading „Света Три Јерарха“; his own entry for 25. јануар closes „(в. 30. јануар)“ and the joint entry gives each of the three his own January day — „Василије 1. јануар, Григорије 25. јануар и Златоуст 27. јануар“. The corpus keeps one feast to a church, so he renders on 25 January only.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 07.02.2026 (25. јануар ст. ст.) — „Свети Григорије Богослов, архиепископ цариградски.“

hymns.text: Fluierul cel păstoresc al teologiei tale a biruit trâmbiţele ritorilor; că ţie, celui ce ai încercat adâncurile duhului, ţi s-au adăugat şi Frumuseţile Cuvântului. Ci, roagă pe Hristos Dumnezeu, Sfinte Părinte Grigorie, să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Ierarh Grigorie Teologul, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului, Glasul 1

english.text: The shepherd's pipe of thy theology overcame the trumpets of the orators; for to thee, who hadst searched out the depths of the Spirit, the beauties of the Word were added also. Wherefore, holy father Gregory, pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Cu limba ta cea de Dumnezeu grăitoare, încurcăturile ritorilor dezlegând, mărite, ai împodobit Biserica cu veşmântul Ortodoxiei, cel ţesut de sus; pe care şi purtându-l, strigă împreună cu noi, fiii tăi: bucură-te părinte, mintea cea preaînaltă a teologiei.

source.text: Doxologia — Condacul Sfântului Ierarh Grigorie Teologul, Arhiepiscopul Constantinopolului, Glasul 3, «Fecioara astăzi...»

english.text: With thy God-speaking tongue, O glorious one, thou didst unravel the tangles of the orators and adorn the Church with the robe of Orthodoxy woven from above; and wearing it, she cries out with us, thy children: rejoice, father, most lofty mind of theology.

hymns.text: Ὁ ποιμενικός αὐλός τῆς θεολογίας σου, τάς τῶν ῥητόρων ἐνίκησε σάλπιγγας· ὡς γάρ τά βάθη τοῦ Πνεύματος ἐκζητήσαντι, καί τά κάλλη τοῦ φθέγματος προσετέθη σοι. Ἀλλά πρέσβευε Χριστῷ τῷ Θεῷ, Πάτερ Γρηγόριε, σωθῆναι τάς ψυχάς ἡμῶν.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Άγιος Γρηγόριος ο Θεολόγος — Ἀπολυτίκιον, Ἦχος α’.

english.text: The shepherd's pipe of your theology overcame the trumpets of the orators; for because you searched out the depths of the Spirit, the beauties of speech were added to you as well. But intercede with Christ God, Father Gregory, that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Θεολόγῳ γλώττῃ σου, τάς συμπλοκάς τῶν ῥητόρων, διαλύσας ἔνδοξε, ὀρθοδοξίας χιτῶνα, ἄνωθεν, ἐξυφανθέντα τῇ Ἐκκλησίᾳ, ἐστόλισας, ὅν καί φοροῦσα, σύν ἡμῖν κράζει, τοῖς σοῖς τέκνοις· Χαίροις Πάτερ, θεολογίας ὁ νοῦς ὁ ἀκρότατος.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), Άγιος Γρηγόριος ο Θεολόγος — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος γ’. «Ἡ Παρθένος σήμερον»

english.text: With your theologian's tongue, glorious one, you undid the entanglements of the orators, and clothed the Church in the garment of Orthodoxy woven from above; and wearing it she cries out with us to her children: Rejoice, Father, the uttermost mind of theology.

hymns.text: Яко апостолов единонравнии/ и вселенныя учителие,/ Владыку всех молите/ мир вселенней даровати// и душам нашим велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 января ст. ст. — «Тропарь святителей»

english.text: As those of one mind with the apostles and teachers of the whole world, entreat the Master of all to grant peace to the world and great mercy to our souls.

hymns.text: Священныя и боговещанныя проповедники,/ верх учителей, Господи,/ приял еси в наслаждение благих Твоих и упокоение:/ труды бо онех и смерть приял еси паче всякаго всеплодия,// Едине прославляяй святыя Твоя.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 30 января ст. ст. — «Кондак святителей»

english.text: The sacred and God-proclaiming preachers, the chief of teachers, thou hast received, O Lord, into the enjoyment of thy good things and into rest; for thou hast accepted their labours and their death above every whole burnt offering, O thou who alone glorifiest thy saints.
